body: I'm not able to reproduce the issue either.

@YeldhamDev I finally managed to reproduce it with a simple scene tree: - Important part is that there is no Button under node B and that node C is a sibling of node B and comes after it. - The filter string needs to be copy-pasted as a whole. Writing it one letter at a time does not trigger this bug (instead of Button the node could be named X and then it would work without copy-pasting). - "Hide Filtered Out Parents" option must be checked. The culprit lies in this part of the `_update_filter_helper` method. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ef02314f2bd0305035ecbe907883401a393da7a7/editor/scene/scene_tree_editor.cpp#L1094-L1116 Notice that there is `return false` at the end. Also notice the `if (prev)` condition. This section is executed when node itself doesn't contain the search term but one of its children does so it will be executed for node C. This section flattens the node hierarchy by moving all children of the node one level up. The `_update_filter_helper` method returns true when the subtree should be kept visible in the scene tree. It should either be visible because the node itself contains the search term or because one of its children should be kept visible. It works recursively. While evaluating node A: 1. It goes through all children of A (namely B and C). 2. It gets false for B because it doesn't contain the search term. 3. It gets false for C because there is `return false` at the end of the section linked above. 5. The hierarchy is flattened so the Button node is now child of the A but because there is another node before node C (`if (prev)` condition is true), the Button is placed after node B and before node C. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ef02314f2bd0305035ecbe907883401a393da7a7/editor/scene/scene_tree_editor.cpp#L1099-L1104 6. There is no next node after C so the node A will not be kept visible. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ef02314f2bd0305035ecbe907883401a393da7a7/editor/scene/scene_tree_editor.cpp#L1057-L1062
